notes: Pre-filtered URL (?country=CR). Confiz is Simplicant/Select2, native <select> hidden 1x1px behind a JS overlay; the country filter is URL-parameterised so we point job_board_url at the filtered view directly (same pattern as 10Pearls' /latin-america-job-openings/). Uses path_prefix=/jobs to bypass the default derivation heuristic because Simplicant URLs are /jobs/<id-slug>/detail with a fixed suffix.
